summary: The new implementation reverses the order of help option names, the opposite of the documented and tested behavior.

findings.explanation: `{name: None for name in reversed(list(ctx.help_option_names))}` builds the dict in reverse, so `["-h", "--help"]` returns `["--help", "-h"]`. The docstring, changelog and most new test cases require declaration order, and this changes the order shown in help for everyone.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop `reversed`: `{name: None for name in ctx.help_option_names}`.
